products.product_description: Winter Citrus Slaw Kit, item #71909, UPC 20728 71909. There are 2/7.2 lbs. bags of multiple ingredients per kit. Each kit contains multiple products and 4/12 oz. bags of Mann Packing Broccoli Cole Slaw: -Mann Packing Broccoli Cole Slaw (4/12 oz bags). -Bacon pieces -Red onion, diced (DM). -Kale, chopped (GF). -Brussels, shredded. -Napa cabbage, shred. -Canned Mandarin orange segments. -Oil/Syrup cup.
products.code_info: Best Used By dates: 11/01/19 and including up to 11/09/19
products.reason_for_recall: The Winter Citrus Slaw Kit, item #71909, is recalled due to a potential contamination of Listeria monocytogenes.
